author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: The `grep` pattern has unescaped quotes that will cause shell parsing errors. The pattern `/nix/store/[^" ]*/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2` contains an unescaped `"` inside the single-quoted string that will break the regex. The inner quote needs to be escaped or the string quoting needs adjustment to prevent shell interpretation issues.
```suggestion
    GLIBC_LD=$(grep -o '/nix/store/[^[:space:]"]*/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2' "$(command -v ldd)" | head -1)
```

source_pr_title: fix(gha-runner): repair stale profile paths; satisfy .NET deps via nix
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Crash Risk**: The loop iterates over all matching files including directories that match the glob pattern. If `patchelf --print-interpreter` is called on a non-ELF file (like scripts or directories), it will fail. While `|| true` suppresses the error, the subsequent case statement will attempt to execute commands on undefined or error output. Add file type validation to prevent processing non-ELF files.
```suggestion
    for f in ./bin/* ./externals/*/bin/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      case "$(patchelf --print-interpreter "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo '')" in
        */ld-linux-x86-64.so.2) [ -n "$GLIBC_LD" ] && patchelf --set-interpreter "$GLIBC_LD" "$f" || true ;;
        */ld-musl-*) [ -f "$MUSL_LD" ] && patchelf --set-interpreter "$MUSL_LD" "$f" || true ;;
      esac
    done
```

source_pr_title: fix(gha-runner): repair stale profile paths; satisfy .NET deps via nix
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: `MUSL_LD` can be an empty string if `nix build` fails (due to `|| true`), but the subsequent check uses `[ -f "$MUSL_LD" ]` which evaluates to true for empty string combined with the `/lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1` suffix, resulting in attempting to use an invalid path. This will cause patchelf operations on musl binaries to silently fail with an invalid interpreter path.
```suggestion
    MUSL_LD_BASE=$(nix build --no-link --print-out-paths "nixpkgs#musl^out" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    MUSL_LD=""
    [ -n "$MUSL_LD_BASE" ] && MUSL_LD="$MUSL_LD_BASE/lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1"
```
